name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Wall Mobilization

instructions.description: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward and toes a short distance from the wall.
Keep the front heel down and bend the front knee toward the wall.
Move in and out of the end range smoothly while keeping the knee aligned over the middle toes.
Repeat several times before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use smooth mobility repetitions rather than a hard static hold.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform the same forward-knee motion from a half-kneeling position.

commentsNotes: If the heel lifts, move the foot slightly closer to the wall.
Do not let the arch collapse excessively.
